body.x: With the support from Gyeonggi Content Agency, O2o (CEO An Seong-min) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its AI-based UI/UX conversation-style cloud application.

The application uses voice search interfacethat allows users to search by voice and hear the results without using theirhands. It uses Google's speech recognition technology, so currently, itsupports more than 22 languages.

Adaptive dialog controls are applied toanalyze user intentions, similar queries, and user preferences based on bigdata. This produces the best answer. Also, since it is the cloud application,there is no need to install other apps.

Through these technologies, o2o offers avariety of services such as interactive tour guides, administrative informationguides, and corporate information. In addition, the company is growing bydeveloping and commercializing AI customer center, interactive content search service,and commercialization, and developing and commercializing interactive localtourism and festival promotion services with local governments.
CEO An said, "We firmly believe thatour application can be a mega trend. We are looking for future partners,potential customers, and investors who can create synergy with us at CES."

Gyeonggi Content Agency is the agency established with the mission to “create future value“ by the integration of the contents, people, and technology in Gyeonggi area. G-HUB, Gyeonggi Global Game Center, Gyeonggi Contents Korea Lab, Export Support System, and Gyeonggi Film Commission are part of the team. The CES 2020 SME participation support is one of the contents-based technology companies' export support programs. Companies that are proven to be competitive more than twice are selected for participation.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance hosted by CTA and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
